job.job_description:
About the Role:

We are looking for a Full Stack Developer to build scalable cloud-native applications powering next-generation intelligence products. The role involves developing highly scalable web applications, dashboards, analytics platforms, and AI-driven operational systems for global shipping customers.

Key Responsibilities:
Design and develop scalable web applications and microservices.
Build responsive user interfaces and analytics dashboards.
Develop RESTful APIs and backend services.
Integrate AI/ML services into customer-facing products.
Optimize applications for performance, scalability, and security.
Collaborate with product managers, data scientists, and DevOps teams.
Participate in architecture discussions and technical decision-making.
Required Skills:
Strong experience in React.js/Next.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and state management libraries (Redux or equivalent).
Hands-on experience with Node.js and/or Python for backend development and REST API design.
Good understanding of Microservices Architecture and scalable application development.
Experience with relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, and Redis.
Proficiency in at least one cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Strong understanding of application performance, scalability, security, and software engineering best practices.



Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
